approval_evidence.quote: NDA 211243 NDA APPROVAL Janssen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ... for Spravato (esketamine) nasal spray ... provides for the use of Spravato (esketamine) nasal spray for treatment of treatment-resistant depression. APPROVAL & LABELING We have completed our review of this application, as amended.

series_start_reason: J&J prints a SPRAVATO line in no schedule before 2023Q1 (absent from every 2014Q3-2022Q4 schedule, measured; esketamine was approved in 2019, so 2019-2021 sales sit in an undisclosed other line - inferred, J&J's 2023Q1 schedule footnote says only that prior-year amounts were reclassified). The 2023Q1 schedule prints 2022Q1 and its supplemental table prints the 2022 quarters and full-year 2021 (224, whole year only). The 2023 quarterly schedules print 2022Q1-Q4 as prior-year columns (70, 85, 100, 119). No document found prints a 2019-2021 quarterly figure, so the series starts at 2022Q1.
notes: Scope is the worldwide (US + Intl) row; J&J prints the same US and Intl rows for every quarter, so the scope is constant. Latest quarter: 2026Q3 comes from Exhibit 99.2 of J&J's 8-K filed 2026-10-13 (the q4cdn PDF for 3Q26 was not yet at the guessed URL, HTTP 404). 2022Q1-Q4 are prior-year columns of the 2023 schedules (the 2022 schedules did not print the product); 2023Q1 onward are each quarter's own schedule. Annual checks: 2022 quarters 70+85+100+119 = 374 (printed in the 4Q23 schedule's 12-month column); 2023: 131+169+183+206 = 689; 2024: 225+271+284+297 = 1,077; 2025: 320+414+459+503 = 1,696, each equal to the 12-month column printed in that year's Q4 schedule. FY2021 = 224 is printed in the 2023Q1 schedule's supplemental table but with no quarterly split, so it is not a row. Date of the US launch (2019) is not asserted: no J&J document read states a launch quarter. Gold is as of 2026Q2; J&J's 2026Q3 schedule (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000020040626000189/a2026q3exhibit992.htm) prints SPRAVATO WW 624.0, left for the next refresh.
search_log: Downloaded J&J's quarterly sales schedule PDFs 2014Q3-2026Q2 (50 PDFs: 'Sales of Key Products/Franchises' through 1Q22, 'Other Financial Disclosures' from 2Q22, plus the 2017Q2 Actelion Historical Sales Schedule) from the J&J investor-site q4cdn URLs used by the existing J&J manifests; parsed every page with pdfplumber and grepped case-insensitively for SPRAVATO, esketamine, INVEGA, HAFYERA, ZAVESCA, miglustat, SYMTUZA, PREZCOBIX, PREZISTA.

Listed J&J (CIK 200406) filings via data.sec.gov submissions and downloaded every 10-Q, 10-K (2017-02 to 2024-02) and every 8-K / 8-K/A exhibit from 2017-01 through the 2026-10-13 8-K (form filter: any form starting 8-K, plus 10-Q and 10-K; 344 exhibit files); grepped for the same names. Product rows with figures exist only for SPRAVATO (10-Qs of 2023 and later, 8-K ex 99.2 of 2023 and later) and for the combined PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA / SYMTUZA line.

Absence claim for 2019Q1-2022Q4: J&J schedules 2019Q1 (inside the 1Q19 press-release attachment) through 2022Q4 contain no SPRAVATO row (0 line hits besides press-release headings in 1Q19); the 2022 10-Qs and the FY2022 10-K have no SPRAVATO row; 8-K ex 99.1 for 2019Q1-2022Q4 mention SPRAVATO only as regulatory-news bullet headings ('(press release)'), no sales figure. Comparative columns of the 2023 schedules (the first to print the product) were used for 2022.

Supplemental Sales Information page of the 2023Q1 schedule prints SPRAVATO 2021 Full Year, 2022 Q1-Q4 and 2022 Full Year (WW 224; 70, 85, 100, 119; 374; the text layer splits some figures with a space, e.g. '2 24').
Other issuers: no partner or royalty holder prints SPRAVATO sales (Janssen develops and sells it; esketamine is not licensed in).
Bigdata.com was not needed for this product: the schedules and EDGAR exhibits located every figure directly.
